user.title: ČHMÚ Weather Station
user.description:
Select a weather station from {stations_count} available stations across Czech Republic.

Nearest station to your location: **{nearest_station}** (approximately {distance} km away)

data_description.station_id: The nearest station measuring temperature is pre-selected based on your Home location. Many automatic stations report precipitation only and expose just that sensor.

unavailable.title: ČHMÚ Weather Station
unavailable.description: Check that Home Assistant can reach opendata.chmi.cz, then submit to try again.

init.title: Weather warnings
init.description: ČHMÚ issues its warnings per ORP (municipality with extended powers). The station stands in **{station_orp}**. Choose another ORP if your home lies across the border of the station's ORP.
